items.title: Mozambique renews Kenmare’s concession for one of world’s largest titanium mines until 2044
items.summary: The Mozambican government has renewed the agreement governing Kenmare’s operations at the Moma titanium mine until 2044, in return for royalties of up to 5%, investments of €185 million and local processing, the company announced yesterday.
